sourcePartsHint: Two RTL-SDRs, addressed by the unique serials we burned in (1000/1001) so a replug can't swap them. Each covers ~2.4 MHz; together they hold the control channel plus the busiest 800 MHz voice cluster. Re-center after watching the logs for 'no recorder' misses -- CRRS voice spans ~851-860 MHz, wider than two dongles cover, so this is a first cut to be tuned against real call distribution.

systems.systemNameHint: Capital Region Radio System (Richmond/Henrico/Chesterfield), P25 Phase II. Control channel 857.0875 confirmed live by scan (-3.4 dB); 858.0375 kept as a fallback candidate. POLICE ARE ENCRYPTED and trunk-recorder skips them automatically; FIRE and EMS are in the clear -- that is what this box exists to capture.

logLevelHint: info is enough to see 'Control Channel' lock and per-call grants; raise to debug only when chasing a problem.
